snippet.title: Holy Justice: Galaxy Outcast (bullet-hell shmup roguelike)
snippet.description:
A cosmic bullet-hell roguelike. Holy Justice is an exhilarating arcade shooter where you upgrade your ship with Core Enhancers, create unexpected combinations, discover unique devices at critical moments, and unleash outrageously powerful builds.

Link to Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3788820?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=new_trailer
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.bigbutton.roguelike.space.shooter&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_campaign%3Dshort
Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/holy-justice-galaxy-outcast/id6748254843
